title: LineageOS Statistics
summary: LineageOS Statistics is a public dashboard that tracks and visualizes usage data for the LineageOS custom Android ROM community, displaying device distribution, Android version adoption rates, and update statistics.
problem_solved: Provides transparency and visibility into LineageOS ecosystem health, device fragmentation, and Android version adoption trends.
why_valuable: Enables the community to understand device popularity, helps developers prioritize device support, and tracks the state of Android version upgrades across the ROM ecosystem.
